venue_evaluation.night_market_blue_awning: tacos, $, light/bright/clean, no cheese or crema. Meets everything. 3 stars.
venue_evaluation.night_market_little_comet: tacos, $, fresh and light, but queso fresco and crema on every taco. Misses dairy intolerance. 2 stars.
venue_evaluation.night_market_tin_star: tacos, light, dairy-free, but $$ (one tier over). 2 stars.
venue_evaluation.night_market_moonlit_corner: tacos, $, dairy-free, but everything fried and greasy. Misses light/fresh. 2 stars.
venue_evaluation.night_market_plum_bridge: $, steamed and light, dairy-free, but dim sum, not tacos. Misses craving. 2 stars.
venue_evaluation.night_market_willow_gate: tacos, light, dairy-free, but $$$ (two tiers over Maya's $). Deal-breaker.

notes: Clean one-miss-each design: every decoy fails exactly one constraint, so the solution is unique and fair.
Liam's cheese line is a nice red herring that turns into the dairy clue via Roxy; he explicitly withdraws it, so no contradiction.

Budget is very explicit ('one-dollar-sign stalls only'), which makes Willow Gate and Tin Star easy to eliminate from the cards alone. Reviews also reinforce price (Willow 'sit-down restaurant prices', Tin Star 'a few dollars more').
Brooke's 'light and fresh' is the subtlest constraint; Moonlit Corner's review makes the fried issue very clear, so it is findable.
Mystery noodle stall mention could briefly tempt players toward Plum Bridge, but Liam closes it off in the next line. Fair.
Slightly on the easy side for level 11; Blue Awning's second review names every constraint (lactose, no cheese/crema) almost directly.
